item.subject: science
item.stem: During a class trip to a pond near her school in Kerala, Meena observes tadpoles swimming in the water and an adult frog sitting on a leaf at the edge. Her teacher asks how each one breathes. Which statement correctly matches each stage of the frog to its breathing organs?

options.A: Tadpoles breathe through lungs; adult frogs breathe through gills only.
options.B: Tadpoles breathe through gills; adult frogs breathe through lungs and moist skin.
options.C: Both tadpoles and adult frogs breathe through lungs and skin.
options.D: Tadpoles breathe through skin; adult frogs breathe through gills.
